006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
009import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
010
011/**
012 * Provides a common implementation for all atomic types that have an underlying
013 * value.
014 *
015 * @param <TYPE>
016 *          the Java type associated with the atomic type.
017 */
018public abstract class AbstractAnyAtomicItem<TYPE>
019    extends AbstractAtomicItemBase<TYPE> {
020  @NonNull
021  private final TYPE value;
022
023  /**
024   * Construct a new atomic item using the provided {@code value}.
025   *
026   * @param value
027   *          the value to assign to this atomic item
028   */
029  protected AbstractAnyAtomicItem(@NonNull TYPE value) {
030    this.value = ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(value, "value");
031  }
032
033  @Override
034  @NonNull
035  public TYPE getValue() {
036    return value;
037  }
038}
